protocol: fixed hyperparameters inherited from the Day-2 local-basis screen

hypotheses.H1: Increasing controlled condition number degrades convergence and/or predictive performance under exact equivalent bases.
hypotheses.H2: Canonicalization substantially shrinks PLE/identity performance gaps.
hypotheses.H3: A function-space first-layer penalty reduces performance spread across equivalent bases.
hypotheses.H4: Nominal categorical contrast conditioning mirrors numerical conditioning.
hypotheses.H5: Exact numerical-categorical block residualization improves optimization or robustness when cross-block dependence is strong.
hypotheses.H6: Leakage-safe residual target encoding helps beyond ordinary target encoding.
hypotheses.H7: Frequency-aware preconditioning improves tail robustness beyond adaptive optimization.
hypotheses.H8: Sparse numeric-by-category cross atoms beat matched controls broadly.

decision_rule: P0 is evaluated before P1/P2. P2 is cut first if P0 does not support a coherent mechanism or if compute is constrained. Null results are retained.
